verdict.rationale: Morph is an AI inference and tooling platform (chat models, Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact, Reflexes), so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no such feature. The canary docs describe gating a provider migration on a slice of production traffic, which is related but is not versioning or rollback of user automations, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
